mentions.name: Scriptdraw
mentions.description: Scriptdraw is a launched website where users generate vector graphics through a scripting language. The goal is to simplify the language further and build many generators for it, such as a gear generator.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was interested in the idea of generating vector graphics with simple scripting language. The "simple" did not happen, but... I launched https://scriptdraw.com and I have lots of fun with it. My goal is to make the language much simpler than it actually is and then create a lot of generators (for example, gears!)
